home2.storyTitle: A family bakery, not a factory
home2.storyText: Every morning before the town wakes up, our ovens are already warm. Three generations of the Sethi family have baked at the same counter in Patti — the same recipes, the same standards, now just a tap away.
home2.cakeCtaText: Pick the size, shape and flavour. Add a photo, write a message. We bake it fresh for your date.
home2.review1Text: Ordered a 2kg Black Forest for my son’s birthday — fresh, beautiful and delivered on time. Highly recommended.
home2.review2Text: Their cream rolls with evening chai are a family tradition for us. Now the kids order online themselves!
home2.review3Text: The eggless red velvet was perfect for our anniversary. The message on the cake was written so beautifully.
home2.galleryText: Follow us on WhatsApp for today’s specials

about.title: About Sethi Bakery
about.lead: A third-generation family bakery serving handmade cakes, pastries and fresh bakes alongside everyday groceries.
about.p1: Sethi Bakery started as a small counter in the main bazaar and has been part of the town’s birthdays, weddings and evening chai for decades. Everything we sell is baked in our own kitchen — never bought in, never day-old.
about.p2: Today the next generation runs the same ovens with the same recipes, and this website brings the counter to your phone: order a custom cake, get fresh patties for a party, or top up the week’s groceries.
about.v1Text: Batches are baked through the day. Anything unsold does not return to the shelf tomorrow.
about.v2Text: Real butter, real cream, and eggless options for every single cake.
about.v3Text: Custom cakes are baked for your date — that’s why we ask for 24 hours’ notice.

policies.title: Delivery & refund policy
policies.delivery1: We deliver across the town and nearby villages through our own rider. Delivery fees and free-delivery thresholds are shown clearly at checkout — no hidden charges.
policies.delivery2: Pickup at the shop is always free. We will keep your order ready at the time you choose.
policies.cakes1: Custom cakes need at least 24 hours’ notice and are baked specifically for your order.
policies.cakes2: Cancellations up to 12 hours before the delivery time receive a full refund. Inside 12 hours the cake is already in production and we can offer a reschedule instead.
policies.refund1: If anything arrives damaged or not fresh, send us a photo on WhatsApp within 2 hours of delivery and we will replace it or refund it — no questions asked.
policies.refund2: Online payments are processed securely by Razorpay. Refunds to the original payment method take 5–7 working days.
